misprints.note: The comma before the termination number is missing in the print. Kept as printed.
Not a misprint: the extra accent comes from the enclitic τινα that follows. Kept as printed.

uncertain.note: The diacritic on the initial υ is stacked and partly broken. It could be read as ὗ (rough breathing with circumflex). I kept ὕβος, the attested form; the ὕβωμα that follows clearly has a rough breathing with an acute.
The second letter is broken type that looks like ι with a crossbar, so the print could read τιλεία. I wrote τελεία as the likely reading.
The α of καθ’ is damaged and looks like ι in the scan. I read it as καθ’.
